item.title: Florida Republican candidate suggests 'sin tax' for OnlyFans creators
item.description: A Republican candidate vying for Florida's next governor has suggested imposing a 50% "sin tax" on OnlyFans incomes.

item.title: Theft leads Sarasota police to multi-state career criminal's arrest: SPD
item.description: A woman's arrest in Osceola County during a traffic stop led officers to recover evidence that linked her to a career of crime, according to the Sarasota Police Department.

item.title: Trump meets with Stanley Cup champions Florida Panthers
item.description: President Donald Trump is receiving the Florida Panthers in the White House's East Room.

item.title: 50 dogs removed from Florida woman's home in illegal breeding operation, deputies say
item.description: A Naples woman accused of illegally breeding and selling dogs as well as practicing veterinary medicine without a license was arrested on Wednesday.

item.title: Dump truck driver flees after ripping down power lines, snapping pole: FHP
item.description: A dump truck with its bed raised plowed into overhead power lines early Thursday in Pinellas County, snapping a utility pole, knocking out power to nearby businesses and then driving away — all caught on camera.

item.title: Florida sheriffs receive reimbursement funds for immigration enforcement actions
item.description: Florida Chief Financial Officer Blaise Ingoglia will speak with several Florida sheriffs on Thursday morning.

item.title: New Tampa Bay Rays CEO making headlines over comments about team's future
item.description: In a recent interview, Rays CEO Ken Babby described the franchise as one of the most distressed teams in professional sports, saying there is no time to waste in finding a new stadium.

item.title: Complaints pile up after long-time solar company abruptly shuts doors
item.description: Complaints are mounting against a Sarasota-based solar company that has been in business for decades, as customers say they paid tens of thousands of dollars for solar projects that were never completed or for warranty work that was never performed.

item.title: Former New College official pleads no contest in indecent exposure case
item.description: A former New College of Florida official accused of exposing himself to multiple people pleaded no contest in court Thursday.

item.title: Shooter kills ex-girlfriend at Bradenton medical complex, turns gun on witness: police
item.description: Bradenton police were at the scene of a homicide Thursday afternoon.
